name: Fancy Post Grid – Ultimate Post Grid Builder
author: RSTheme

sections.description:
Fancy Post Grid – Ultimate Post Grid Builder is a modern WordPress plugin for creating
responsive post layouts such as grids, sliders, lists, and carousels without writing code.

The plugin works seamlessly with Elementor, Gutenberg, and shortcodes, making it suitable
for blogs, magazines, news portals, and content-driven websites.

Version 2.0.0 is a major milestone and represents a complete rewrite of the plugin to ensure
better performance, security, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

Key Features

  • Multiple layout types: Grid, Slider, Carousel, List
  • Elementor widgets with drag-and-drop controls
  • Gutenberg blocks with live preview
  • Shortcode generator for flexible placement
  • Advanced query builder (categories, tags, include/exclude posts)
  • Fully responsive controls (desktop, tablet, mobile)
  • Optimized asset loading and dependency management
  • Translation-ready with updated POT file
  • Clean, secure, and performance-focused codebase

Requirements

  • WordPress version 6.3 or higher
  • PHP version 7.4 or higher

Support

For documentation, updates, and support, visit:
https://wordpress.org/plugins/fancy-post-grid/
sections.installation:
Using the WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Fancy Post Grid”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Uploading via WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Click Upload Plugin
  3. Upload fancy-post-grid.x.x.x.zip
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Activate the plugin

Using FTP

  1. Download fancy-post-grid.x.x.x.zip
  2. Extract the zip file
  3. Upload the fancy-post-grid folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  4. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen

upgrade_notice.2.0.0:
IMPORTANT: Major Release – Complete Refactor

Version 2.0.0 is a full architectural rewrite of Fancy Post Grid. The internal codebase is completely different from version 1.0.2 and earlier.

What changed:

  • Entire plugin rebuilt using a modular, class-based architecture
  • Removed all legacy logic, deprecated helpers, and unused code
  • Introduced modern asset management with proper dependency handling
  • Rewritten Elementor integration for better stability and performance
  • Deprecated old shortcode layouts and legacy Gutenberg blocks
  • Added a new scalable settings panel
  • Centralized sanitization and escaping for improved security
  • Improved compatibility with future WordPress and PHP versions

IMPORTANT: If you were using old shortcode layouts or removed blocks, you may need to recreate those layouts using the new widgets, blocks, or shortcodes available in version 2.0.0.
